entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: An ogre slave-master of the Murasa continent of Zendikar who owns the Cliffs of Kazuul and mines in Murasa's Wall.

entities.name: Cliffs of Kazuul
entities.description: The only easy entry into Murasa, controlled by Kazuul.

entities.name: North Hada
entities.description: A place from which slaves are bought.

entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: A place from which slaves are bought.

events.summary: Kazuul demands tribute from travelers using the Cliffs of Kazuul, casting out those who cannot pay, sometimes to their deaths.
events.quote: Those who reach the top without proper tribute for Kazuul are cast out

events.summary: Kazuul's agents bring him slaves bought from North Hada or Zulaport to work his mines inside Murasa's Wall.
events.quote: His agents bring him slaves of all races
